  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Crow
    A crow: a stateful creature that cycles between Perching, Foraging, Mobbing, and Fleeing.
    CrowNavigation
    The steps an actor can take from where it stands: one tile toward, or away from, a reference Location.
    CrowSensing
    What a crow can sense from where it stands: food, other actors, and whether it is crowded.
    Fleeing
    The crow panics and keeps moving away from the closest actor until it has felt safe for long enough to calm down.
    ForageableItems
    Met by the tiles that hold an Item worth foraging: one that the creature has not already hidden away itself.
    Foraging
    The crow seeks out the nearest item lying on the ground and, once it reaches it, carries it off to a hidden spot instead of eating it on the spot.
    Mobbing
    The crow has spotted a lone actor and dives in to harass them.
    Perching
    The crow's default, idle state: wanders aimlessly around the map, watching for food or for actors to mob.
